name: HassActronQueNeoIntegration
description: Actron Que/Neo Air Conditioner Add-On for Home Assistant (https://blog.mikejmcguire.com/2021/02/11/actron-neo-and-home-assistant/) This add-on for Home Assistant enables you to control an Actron Air Conditioner equipped with the Actron Que or Actron Neo modules. The add-on requires you to use the Mosquitto MQTT broker on your Home Assistant device, with authentication enabled and a valid credential supplied. You'll also need to ensure that MQTT discovery is enabled with the default prefix 'homeassistant' for HA to discover the climate device and zone switches.
